name: reflexivity_0
description: Fixed universal reflexivity clause instantiated at a numeral.

name: reflexivity_1
description: Fixed universal reflexivity clause instantiated at a numeral.

name: reflexivity_2
description: Fixed universal reflexivity clause instantiated at a numeral.

name: ordinary_open_default_wrong_left
description: Default export: base is 0=0 but row 1 has literal zero rather than the fresh witness on its left.

name: ordinary_open_despite_extraction
description: The row forces replacement b->0, but a witness-free branch result still gives ordinary elimination.

name: ordinary_open_default_wrong_base
description: Row 1 is b=1, but the base is 1=1; the exact syntactic 0=0 test forces the default mode.

name: extracted_target_contains_witness
description: Extracts b=C(b,0,b), whose right side still contains b. A witness-free branch is legally exported; an occurs check would wrongly reject.

name: symmetry_from_assumption
description: Reconstructs symmetry using the first-row naming package under an actual equation assumption.

name: successor_congruence
description: Reconstructs successor congruence; no primitive equality or transport instruction is used.

name: transitivity_uses_two_equalities
description: Uses the assumed 0=1 and derived 1=2 as separate premises of derived transitivity.

name: repeated_template_occurrences
description: The transport parameter occurs in both the counter and initializer.

name: passive_source_occurrence
description: The numerical source 1 is also a passive initializer; replacing the fresh alias must preserve it.

name: nested_iterator_congruence
description: Congruence under two iterator-state binders with a live universally quantified parameter.

name: equation_induction_uses_hypothesis
description: The progress branch genuinely uses its induction hypothesis to prove I(y,0;u.Su)=y.

name: zero_witness_case_repair
description: A fresh alias repairs atomic case introduction at zero and consumes the base assumption 0=1.

name: nested_formula_substitution
description: Exports through two D binders and nested iterator bodies; b->0 creates computation redexes that must normalize capture freely.

name: compound_matrix_default_open
description: A D-rooted matrix cannot supply an equation row; ordinary elimination still works.

name: essential_left_guard_false_equality
description: Deleting the left-witness test accepts false 1=0: row 1 is 0=0 and row 2 is Z(b)=0.

name: essential_base_guard_false_closure
description: Deleting the exact base test exports a closure whose base is true and whose second row is 1=0.

name: default_eigenvariable_escape
description: The default mode cannot erase a fresh witness from a reflexive branch equation.

name: outer_scope_guard_escape
description: Removing current-goal scope validation accepts a free eigenparameter in the purported closed conclusion.

name: false_equality
description: Rejects 0=1.

name: wrong_clause_antecedent
description: The extracted equality is not free-standing: clause use must supply the actual 0=0 antecedent.

name: old_explicit_packet_not_accepted
description: The old seven-field E packet is not a deterministic-discharge certificate.

name: invalid_major
description: An equation proof cannot serve as a D major.

name: invalid_branch
description: The branch must prove its declared formula before export.

name: negative_clause_index
description: Negative context indices are rejected.

name: boolean_clause_index
description: Booleans are not clause indices.

name: boolean_term
description: Booleans are not numerical terms.

name: string_term
description: Strings are not numerical terms.

name: extra_proof_field
description: Exact packet arity is checked.

name: extra_document_field
description: Exact public key set is checked.

name: empty_proof
description: Missing proof instruction is rejected.

name: loose_bound_variable
description: A bound variable cannot escape to the outer scope.

name: malformed_formula
description: Empty formulas are rejected.

name: noncanonical_zero_iterator
description: Goals must already be full normal forms.

name: nested_binder_capture_mismatch
description: An unrelated bound-coordinate result cannot replace the capture-avoiding normalized export.
